answer.summary: Spring context fails to start in the API test shard because of a circular bean dependency: workflowService -> workflowEndService -> notificationEventService -> scenarioNotificationEventHandler -> exerciseService -> workflowService. The change touches WorkflowEndService and NotificationEventService, and the failure repeats across every test class that loads the app context (2 prior persists, 0 flakes). Re-running will fail the same way. Fix the cycle, for example by breaking the dependency or using a lazy or event-based hook.
